capability: Traffic-light status on every join, never repainted
title: Keep the red join red.

hook.picture: Close: three team lines meet at two joins. One join glows terracotta. The whale, holding a paint roller, swipes it green in one stroke.
hook.words: Just mark it green for now.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: Every team says green, but the project is late.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: a programme lead in the Monday status meeting

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: a board of many team lines. Three times, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, a red join is painted green, and each time the paint cracks sooner.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Bad news gets painted over, every week.

stakes.body: The client finds the problem before you do, and trust in every report drops.

solution_hint: Show where teams disagree. Never paint over.

metaphor.body: Team reports are lines that meet at joins. Each join carries a traffic light that is set by reading both sides, and paint will not stick to it.

steps.picture: Each join between two team lines gets a small light. The whale sets it by reading both ends: teal if they match, orange if partly, terracotta if not.
steps.words: Show where teams disagree. Never paint over.
steps.sound: Two tones per join; unison for teal.

steps.picture: Lights settle: most teal, one orange, one terracotta. The whale tries a green swipe on the terracotta light, and the paint slides off.
steps.words: Paint will not stick to a real gap.
steps.sound: A wet slide, then the beating pair again.

steps.picture: Push-in on the orange join: a small card hangs from it saying why, kept beside the light where everyone can read it.
steps.words: Keep the reason next to the light.
steps.sound: Soft tick as the card hangs.

steps.picture: Chips appear on the lights: the colour key. A caption names what the light shows.
steps.words: This light shows the glue colour.
steps.sound: Three tones: unison, half-beat, full beat.

real_case.claim: The JEV ELDER collector map keeps its open items (δ1 to δ8) listed as do not fold. Its glue stays orange until δ2 and δ3 close or are parked.

honest_limit.picture: Push to the terracotta light: it is lit and honest, but no pod comes. Dust settles on it while the team lines move on past it.
honest_limit.words: Everyone can see it. Nobody fixes it.

not_this.body: Shown is not the same as solved.

ending_pattern.body: The paint roller is set down, the red light stays red, and an owner pod arrives. The board is honest, and the client is no longer surprised.
ending_pattern.callback: Bar 1's green swipe is refused at the same join, which gets an owner instead, and the client's ✕ becomes ✓.

end_belief.body: Report the real colour. Name who fixes it.

sound.signature: Each join is two tones: unison for teal, a slow beat for orange, a fast beat for terracotta.
sound.problem_motif: A cheerful major chord with one string flat underneath.

score_self.reason: Painting over red is an instantly legible leader pain. The case maps cleanly onto a real orange collector. Risk: "glue colour" may read as jargon even after its picture.
